apparatus: Mt 6:5-9 preface quoted in full as Origen prints it.
Jn 5:44 'only God' glory-saying applied to prayer-motive.
Lk 16:25 rich-man analogy for exhausted reward.
Gal 6:8 sowing/reaping applied to alms and prayers.

choices.english: pressing against ambition as a passion that destroys
choices.why: enistamenos = bearing down/pressing; ambition is a pathos unto ruin — Origen diagnoses, not merely scolds.
Forced comparative of 'unlying': Jesus' oath makes the true word more-than-true — Origen flags the forcing himself (βιαζόμενον).

lemmas.gloss: they have received in full, drawn off
lemmas.lexica: LSJ: receive in full; Mt 6 'have their reward'

pass_a_gloss: Matthew's pre-prayer sayings frame prayer against ambition: hypocrites' street-corner theater, closet secrecy, heathen wordiness. Vainglory pollutes even good deeds; Jesus' oath-backed 'they have received their reward' parallels the rich man's exhausted good things and the flesh-sower's corruption. The broad way is all corners; pleasure-lovers get drunk on prayer itself, fallen from the unbending narrow way.
